# protonmail-mcp-server

> A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing read-only access to Proton Mail through Proton Bridge.

## Tools

- proton_list_folders: List all mailbox folders with message and unread counts
- proton_list_emails: List emails in a folder with pagination, returns summaries (subject, from, date, snippet)
- proton_search_emails: Search emails by sender, recipient, subject, body text, date range, read/flagged status
- proton_get_email: Read a single email's full content by IMAP UID

## Requirements

- Proton Mail account (any plan)
- Proton Bridge running locally (provides IMAP access)
- Node.js 18+

## Privacy

- Read-only: cannot send, delete, or modify emails
- No disk caching: email content is never written to the filesystem
- Localhost-only: connects to Proton Bridge on 127.0.0.1 by default
- No credential logging: Bridge password is never logged or exposed
